lines.en: I run across the sand at a trot.
My legs are thin and quick.
I keep my head down and push on.
I go round a piece of bone.
I run the dune's edge.

lines.zh: 我的背上有条状的花纹。
lines.en: Bands run down my back.
Sand scatters under my feet.
I run from shadow into light.

lines.zh: 我在沙丘顶上停了一下。
lines.en: I pause on the dune's crest.
Then I run down the slope again.
I stand with my head forward.
My legs tremble slightly.
I'm listening under the sand.
My mouthparts open and close.
I'm not waiting for anything.

lines.zh: 我身上的纹在光里很清楚。
lines.en: My bands show clearly in the light.
I've no need to hide.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把腿换了个姿势。
lines.en: I shift my legs slowly.
The swarm is under this dune.
I lower my head and sniff.
There's a sound beyond the dune.
I brace all my legs and stand.

lines.zh: 太阳把我的影子压短了。
lines.en: The sun has shortened my shadow.
You're standing on the dune.
My head is already turned to you.
All six legs brace.
You're full of water.
I'm sizing up the distance.
You've planted your feet.
My mouthparts open wide.
I haven't backed off.

lines.zh: 你的影子拖过了整片沙。
lines.en: Your shadow stretches across the sand.
You've put your weight on your front foot.

lines.zh: 我看着你抬起来的那只手。
lines.en: I'm watching that raised hand.
There's a steep slope behind you.
I tighten the circle little by little.
Your blade is throwing light.

lines.zh: 我数着你还有几步可退。
lines.en: I'm counting the steps you have left.
I back two paces, legs still braced.
One of my legs breaks mid-stride.
My back plate has split.
I don't make a sound.
I straighten my body again.
My mandibles won't meet.
I shake out my six legs.
I can still run like this.
I turn my head back your way.
I've no interest in that.
I glance at it and don't lower my head.
I kick it aside with a leg.

lines.zh: 这种玩意虫群碰都不碰。
lines.en: The swarm won't touch that stuff.
You hold it up; I freeze and watch.
The smell doesn't draw me.
I go right around it.
Keep it; I don't need it.
I've moved a little further from it.
You charge and I dodge to the side.
All six legs brace at once.
That cost me only one step.
My leg scrapes across you.
We press a hollow in the sand.
I square myself again.
I shake out all six legs.
I don't leave that line.
The sand is narrow — we each give a step.
She comes up the far side of the dune.
Her bands are denser than mine.

lines.zh: 我们并排站在顶上一会儿。
lines.en: We stand together on the crest a while.
Her foreleg touches mine.

lines.zh: 我们都不发出一点声音。
lines.en: Neither of us makes a sound.

lines.zh: 她用口器碰了碰我的头。
lines.en: She touches her mouthparts to my head.
We run down together.
She's faster than I am.
She slips into a tunnel in the sand.

lines.zh: 我在外面又站了一会儿。
lines.en: I stand outside a while longer.
It breaks under my mouthparts.
I drag it into the sand.
I turn it over with a leg.
Soil clings to it.
I sweep it back to your feet.
I don't touch it again.
The sand covers it quickly.
I go looking for something else.
I've seen it right now.
I lower my head and aim at you.
All six legs start moving at once.
I cut toward you.
Sand flies up under me.
You've backed onto the dune's slope.
I'm a few steps faster.
Both my mandibles are wide open.
I start charging forward.

lines.zh: 我把四只眼都对准了你。
lines.en: All four of my eyes are on you.
I'm charging in now.
I'll be right at you in a moment.
The sand rings under my claws.
Only a few steps between us now.
Now there are only these few steps left.
I can bite you from here.
I cut across the whole way.
I know this sand better than you.
You'll slow on the slope.
I go round below the slope.
I run at your flank.
You raise an arm before your face.
I've got faster.
I've launched myself into the air.
I spread every leg.
This lands on your back.
I'm down on top of you.
Your breathing starts to catch.
There are two hollows in the sand.
Another bite — the fangs still hold.
That's more than enough for you.
My forelegs rake down.
My mouthparts bite into your shoulder.
I spring onto it from the flank.
I sweep my leg at your ankle.
My foreleg hooks your ankle.
I pull off and lunge back in.
You cut my leg; I pull back.
I press down with every leg spread.
This bite lands on your neck.
You go down on the sand.
I circle you, low on the sand.

lines.zh: 我的斑纹，在沙里最显眼。
lines.en: My stripes show in the sand.
The swarm will come soon.
I pull back a little first.
The dune's slope bulges.

lines.zh: 我从沙里钻出来，六条腿先着地。
lines.en: I come up and land on all six.
My mandibles open for the first time.

lines.zh: 背上的花纹在阳光下很亮。
lines.en: My back bands shine in the sun.
I stand on the slope a while.
The hive is right below here.

lines.zh: 我拿两条腿试了试快慢。
lines.en: I test my speed on two legs.
Sand runs off my legs.
It's fiercely hot here.
Something moves far off.
My shadow stretches on the sand.

lines.zh: 风把我的气味吹向沙丘。
lines.en: The wind scatters my scent toward the dunes.
I head down the slope.
The swarm is starting to move.

lines.zh: 刚钻出沙，我的心跳很快。
lines.en: Fresh from the sand, my heart beats fast.
I turn around on the crest.

lines.zh: 我顺着坡一路滚到坡底。
lines.en: I tumble all the way down the slope.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的口器，我往上爬。
lines.en: Water floods my mouthparts; I climb up.
The blast throws me into the sand.

lines.zh: 一支尖东西卡在我甲缝。
lines.en: Something sharp sticks in my seam.
The light pins my legs where they are.

lines.zh: 雷落在沙上，我缩成一团。
lines.en: Lightning hits the sand and I curl small.
No sand, no ground — I fall.
